page.overview:
Who is Dan Harbor?

Dan Harbor is a major character in Hide-and-Seek, the third story in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He's Toby's friendly boss and owner of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and Games.

Dan has a big chest with meaty arms but short, skinny legs. He also has a thick beard.

Dan is a friendly boss that’s always nice towards his employees. He enjoys having families together and entertaining them, which is why he loves Freddy’s. When others disrespect the restaurant and destroy his property, Dan gets very upset and annoyed.
